senses.gloss:
† पिठ् पिठ्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To hurt.
 2. To feel pain.

पिठर पिठर
 I. m. and f. री, and n. A pot, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1782; a pan.
 II. m.
 1. A kind of fire, Hariv. 10467.
 2. The name of a Dānava.
पिठरक पिठर + क, A pot, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 729.

पीठ पीठ n. and m.
 1. A stool, a seat, a chair, MBh. 5, 1399; a bench.
 2. A base or pedestal, Rājat. 2, 126.
 3. The seat of a deity, an altar, Rājat. 5, 46; 473.
 4. A kind of ornament, Hariv. 8063.
 --Comp.

पीठक पीठ + क,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A chair, a bench.
 2. A saddle(?), MBh. 1, 3486.
 II. f. ठिका.
 1. A bench.
 2. The section of a literary work, Daśak. 48, 7.
पीठग पीठ-ग, adj. Lame (moving by means of a small car), MBh. 3, 871.

पीठमर्द पीठमर्द, i. e. पीठ-मृद् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Mounted on horses(?), MBh. 4, 674.
 2. Very impudent, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 13(?).
 II. m.
 1. The companion of a hero.
 2. A dancing master of courtesans.
पीठसर्प पीठ-सर्प, i. e. पीठ-सृप् + अ, adj. sbst. Lame, a cripple (cf. पीठग), MBh. 3, 1397.
पीठ- + सर्पिन् पीठ- + सर्पिन्, m. a cripple, Man. 8, 394.
